title: Fog on the Log
lines: Fog! Tom and Mom can not see a lot.
"The dog is not in his box," said Mom.
Tom and Mom look and look in the fog.
A red pot! It is on the log.
"The dog naps at the log!" said Tom.
Mom and Tom run to the red pot.
The dog got up and ran to Tom.
"You got us to the dog," said Mom.

questions.ask: Why could Mom and Tom not see the dog?
questions.listenFor: The fog. Lines one and two say it. Let your child reread rather than being told.

questions.ask: What did Tom spot that showed him where the dog was?
questions.listenFor: A red pot sitting on a log. Lines four and five say it. This is the turn of the story.

questions.ask: Find the line that shows the dog was glad to see Tom. Read it to me.
questions.listenFor: Line seven — the dog got up and ran to Tom. Let them find it rather than hearing it from you.
